g.text: Presenting (ADR-0045): F5 → window-level fullscreen owned by main → Escape
decide {want? yes, is? no} → {set true, owned true}
(CSS hides the menu bar, sidebar, tabs, address bar,
bottom bar and status bar; the slide sits on black)
set-layout! :slides when needed (the page is kept);
the window grew: the ResizeObserver resizes the slots
during the show (the state diagram has the details)
→ · Space · Shift+→ · digits + Enter · b / w · Tab · a click
a slide step runs at once inside the key handler (commands/dispatch-now! →
scroll delegate → renderer.pdf/step!); a blanked screen or a half-typed number
goes through [:slides/command] first, which only unblanks / forgets the digits
escape-fx, first match: palette? find bar?
decide {want? no, is? yes, owned? yes}
[the user had made the window fullscreen before the show]
decide {want? no, is? yes, owned? no}
pdf/update! {:presenting? false}: the 16 px margin returns;
the layout returns to this view's own (its choice, or detection);
the window leaves fullscreen first (F11, the window manager)
the show asked for it, and now it is not →
(there is no fullscreen left to leave)
main: the fullscreen decision, the BrowserWindow
A document's /PageMode /FullScreen never reaches this path: it is deck evidence only.
